en: The image shows the front and back of an old postcard. The front features a black-and-white photograph of a mountain lodge or inn with several cars parked outside, surrounded by a rocky landscape and forested hills. The caption at the bottom of the photo reads 'Koča pri Izviru Soče.' The back side contains handwritten text, postmarks, and stamps, indicating it was mailed. There are several official stamps and a visible postmark with the location 'Bovec.'
